events.title: Frontier AI and the Public Sector: Fireside Chat with Katrina Mulligan (OpenAI)
events.location: Room 422, Hopkins Bloomberg Center, 555 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.description: Fireside chat moderated by Prof. Olga Belogolova with OpenAI's head of national security partnerships, a former DoD, DOJ, IC and NSC official, on how governments use frontier AI. Lunch from 12:15; RSVP required.
events.why: Direct access to the person running OpenAI's national-security government partnerships, hosted by ETI's director in Room 422.

events.title: Boundary Breakers: Tech & National Security Showcase
events.location: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg Center, 555 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.host: Emerging Technologies Initiative, JHTV, Technical.ly and Squadra Ventures
events.description: Second annual showcase during DC Startup & Tech Week on critical technology innovations in national security: R&D and deployment stories from entrepreneurs, researchers and scientists, plus eight lightning talks (applications open).
events.why: ETI-co-hosted networking showcase linking defense-tech founders and researchers with policy students; students can apply to give a lightning talk.

events.title: The Infrastructure Behind Intelligence: How Energy Innovation Will Scale AI
events.location: Room 422, Hopkins Bloomberg Center, 555 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.host: Energy and Environment Club at SAIS
events.description: Student-club event on the power and energy-innovation constraints on scaling AI compute and data centers. RSVP via Hopkins Groups.
events.why: Covers the energy bottleneck for AI build-out, a core compute-policy question, in Room 422.

events.title: JHU Data Science and AI Institute Fall 2026 Symposium: Artificial Intelligence and Human Learning
events.host: Johns Hopkins Data Science and AI Institute
events.description: University-wide symposium on AI and learning across three themes: foundations, ethics and applications.
events.why: AI ethics content, but focused on education and held in Baltimore, so a stretch for DC students.
